defs.def: connected with education, especially studying in schools and universities 学业的，教学的，学术的（尤指与学校教育有关）

ex.s: Academic disciplines are of equal importance.
ex.t: 各学科具有同等重要性。

ex.s: Still, in room 386, academics don’t come first.
ex.t: 在386号房间,

ex.s: When asked why they chose so many AP classes, my friends responded: “I don’t know.” They themselves don’t know why they are following the crowd and longing for the pressures of academic difficulty.
ex.t: 当被问及为什么选择这么多AP课程时，我的朋友们回答说：“我不知道。”他们自己也不知道为什么要随大流，为什么渴望学业压力。

ex.s: her own understanding of successB. her desire for academic challenges
ex.t: 她对成功的理解B.她对学术挑战的渴望

ex.s: *Academic department assistant (Flexible working hours on Monday/Thursday)
ex.t: *学术部门助理（周一/周四工作时间灵活）

ex.s: Work permit and Academic report.
ex.t: 工作许可和学业成绩单。

ex.s: Let’s get started by checking out Student Guide for your academic journey!
ex.t: 让我们先来看看《学生指南》，开启你的学术之旅吧！

ex.s: If, at a later date, you wish to apply for a job or graduate school where an official copy of your UCLA record is required, it will be to your advantage to provide an impressive academic record.
ex.t: 如果在以后的日子里，你申请的工作或研究生院需要你的加州大学洛杉矶分校成绩单的正式副本，那么提供一份令人印象深刻的学业记录将对你有好处。

ex.s: Present past academic records to UCLA.
ex.t: 向加州大学洛杉矶分校提交过去的学业成绩。

ex.s: Hundreds of scientists, writers and academics sounded a warning to humanity in an open letter published last December: Policymakers and the rest of us must engage openly with the risk of global collapse.
ex.t: 数百名科学家、作家和学者去年12月在发表的一封公开信中向人类发出警告：政策制定者和我们所有人都必须公开面对全球崩溃的风险。

ex.s: Back when science—then called “the new philosophy”—took shape, academics looked to craftsmen for help in understanding the natural world.
ex.t: 早在科学——当时被称为『新哲学』——成形之时，学者们就向工匠寻求帮助，以理解自然世界。

ex.s: ESL courses are designed to help international students improve academic English language skills.
ex.t: ESL 课程旨在帮助国际学生提升学术英语水平。

ex.s: We could also say Throughout history and across the world, many great thinkers have used the image of war to describe their quest for academic achievement in a romantic way.
ex.t: 我们也可以说，纵观历史和世界各地，许多伟大的思想家都以浪漫的方式使用战争的形象来描述他们对学术成就的追求。

ex.s: He still longed to become known for his historical novels amongst other academic works.
ex.t: 他仍然渴望以其历史小说和其他学术作品而闻名。

ex.s: Doyle’s many historical novels, plays, poems and academic papers have remained largely forgotten, but Sherlock Holmes has been entertaining readers for well over a century.
ex.t: 道尔的许多历史小说、戏剧、诗歌和学术论文在很大程度上仍然被遗忘，但福尔摩斯一个多世纪以来一直在娱乐读者。

defs.def: involving a lot of reading and studying rather than practical or technical skills 学术的（与实践性、技术性相对）

ex.s: She writes from the practical angle of a business person rather than as an academic, making for a guide which is highly accessible and informative and which, by the close, will make you feel almost as smart as AI.
ex.t: 她从一个商人的实用角度而非学者角度写作，使这本指南极易读又有信息量，读到最后会让你觉得自己几乎和AI一样聪明。

ex.s: Lianda: a Place of Passion, Belief and Commitment Throughout history, the great thinkers of the world have often rather romantically referred to their academic struggles as being like “war”.
ex.t: Lianda ：一个充满激情、信仰和承诺的地方纵观历史，世界上伟大的思想家们经常相当浪漫地将他们的学术斗争称为“战争”。

ex.s: These linguistic skills enabled him to achieve many impressive accomplishments over the course of his academic career, including translations of notable works such as The Young Lions, The Moneychangers and The Death of the Moth.
ex.t: 这些语言技能使他在学术生涯中取得了许多令人印象深刻的成就，包括翻译《年轻的狮子》、《货币兑换者》和《飞蛾之死》等著名作品。

defs.def: good at subjects involving a lot of reading and studying 学习良好的

ex.s: She worries about her academic ability.
ex.t: 她担心自己的学习能力。

ex.s: Through it all, she remained in good academic standing and graduated with honors.
ex.t: 在整个过程中她保持了良好的学术成绩并以优异成绩毕业。

defs.def: not connected to a real or practical situation and therefore not important 纯理论的；空谈的；学究式的
